name: Orangutan
description: Orangutan is a Heavyweight Heads original creation. Its piney, citrus aroma paired with a sweet and sour, skunky taste will captivate your senses and have you coming back for more. The effects will give you an initial boost of energy then slowly settle into a soothing, creative high that lasts for hours.
